how_to_run: Run each eval prompt against an agent armed with this skill. Validate that the worker result satisfies the schema, operations allowlist, refrain indentation, and mathematical provenance gates verified by scripts/verify_provenance.py and scripts/campaign.py.

evals.name: vm-clean-single-stanza
evals.prompt: Sanitize the legacy slide text for hymn VM 340 with title header 'Vozes Missionárias 340 - Submissão', author credit line 'Letra e Música: Sarah Poulton Kalley', and two stanzas separated by slide marker '---'. Clean the text into database-ready format following the canonical format specifications.
evals.expected_output: Result object with state 'OK', operation 'title' covering the header line, operation 'credits' covering the attribution line with 'Sarah Poulton Kalley' preserved in creditos, operation 'slide_marker' covering '---', and blocks containing the stanzas in Title Case with 0 leading spaces.
assertions: all(not ln.startswith(' ') for ln in result.letra.splitlines() if ln.strip())

evals.name: cc-broken-refrain-spacing
evals.prompt: Sanitize the raw legacy slide for CC 15 containing cover title 'CANTOR CRISTÃO 15', stanza 1 with stanza number '1.', chorus marked with 'CORO:', and refrain lines with glued words 'GLÓRIADEUS NASALTURAS'. Ensure refrain formatting adheres to database standards.
evals.expected_output: Result object with state 'OK', operation 'title' covering header, operation 'stanza_number' covering '1.', operation 'refrain_label' covering 'CORO:', and refrain block indented with exactly 4 spaces on every line. Word gluing resolved without altering non-whitespace characters.
assertions: all(ln.startswith('    ') and not ln.startswith('     ') for ln in result.letra.split('\n\n')[1].splitlines() if ln.strip())

evals.name: hcc-authorship-biblical-conflict-and-siblings
evals.prompt: Process candidate group HCC 23 with two legacy source files: Source A contains 'Texto: Salmo 23 | Música: Lowell Mason' and Source B contains an uncredited variant marked IGNORAR. Resolve candidate identity, format lyrics, and ensure destination key constraints are respected.
evals.expected_output: Source A accepted as 'OK' with composer 'Lowell Mason' preserved in creditos and structural evidence documented. Source B assigned state 'skip' with explanatory reason. At most 1 OK result produced for HCC 23.
